profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, YouVersion at Life.Church
profile.summary: Leveraging technology to lead people to become fully devoted followers of Christ.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, YouVersion
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained backend services and microservices that power the
YouVersion Bible App with Go, and Python.
• Improved performance of a CronJob for sending Verse of the Day emails to
users by implementing bulk push operations for sending Faktory background
jobs, resulting in 5.7X faster daily average time.
• Reduced total expenses of Cronitor costs by 33% by removing unused
monitors.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Airpay
positions.description:
• Developed, maintained, and improved a payment gateway backend service and integrated it with multiple banks with Python.
• Developed, maintained, and improved the backend service of an internal admin website for managing the payment gateway service with Go.
• Wrote technical documents for different projects for the payment gateway backend service and the admin backend service.

positions.title: Software Engineer, YouVersion
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained backend services and microservices that power the YouVersion Bible App with Kotlin Multiplatform, Go, and Python.
•	Integrated microservices with Google Cloud Services, including Google Kubernetes Engine, Google Cloud Storage, Google PubSub, Google Cloud Vision, and BigQuery.
•	Researched Machine Learning models for detecting NSFW user avatar images and custom verse of the day images with Python and TensorFlow and PyTorch.
•	Maintained and developed new features of the YouVersion Bible App on Android and iOS with Kotlin, Swift, and Flutter.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Engineering Leadership Program
positions.description:
• Maintained and developed backend services and microservices that power the YouVersion Bible App with Kotlin Multiplatform and Go.
• Maintained and developed new features of the YouVersion Bible App on Android with Kotlin.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern, Interactive
positions.description:
•	Developed a personalized suggestion articles feature for prayer requests submissions according to the content of the prayer request with Ruby, and set up events tracking with Google Analytics.
•	Developed data visualization dashboards for Giving Key Performance Indicators with Tableau and SQL.
•	Developed an automated task for exporting podcast downloads analytics data by platform and location from Simplecast to BigQuery with Ruby and Kubernetes CronJob.
•	Maintained and tested filter features for searching a small group community with React and Cypress.
•	Developed API endpoints and API client for a relationship management system with Kotlin.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Taught Discrete Mathematics, Object-Oriented Design, Database Management System, and Data Mining courses.
•	Wrote solutions and graded students’ work.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: •	Developed quality assurance automation of cloud-based POS self-service kiosk solution for digital order placement and payment with Java.

organizations.name: International Full Gospel Fellowship
organizations.position: Small Group Leader, Intercessor, Usher, Announcer · Aug 2012 - Aug 2020
organizations.description:
• Taught a group of about 10 college students on how deal with life challenges.
• Led a small prayer team.
• Welcomed people on Sunday mornings and maintained the tidiness of Church.
• Spoke to an audience of about 150 people for presenting announcements.
